timezone.description:
Timezone is an IANA name such as "Africa/Lagos". The reminder scheduler
resolves it on every tick, so it is validated on write.

quota.description:
Quota is the allowance after this message was counted, so the client can
update its counter without a follow-up GET /ai/quota.
